newsitem.title: NORWAY: Jagland pledges economic continuity in Norway.
newsitem.headline: Jagland pledges economic continuity in Norway.

text.p: Norway's new Labour prime minister Thorbjoern Jagland said on Tuesday his government would continue the economic policies of his predecessor Gro Harlem Brundtland.
He told parliament the minority government's goals remained to achieve full employment and create an ecologically sustainable society.

"The government will carry forward the policy of the Harlem Brundtland government," he added. "It is of special importance to have the economy firmly under control so that the high oil profits the country will enjoy in the next few years do not turn into new price rises destructive to society.
"This is the foundation for a continued fight against unemployment."
Jagland last Friday replaced Brundtland, who has dominated Norwegian politics for 15 years and was in office for 10 of them.
Brundtland stepped down to give heir apparent Jagland the opportunity to warm up to the task of leading the government into the general election in September next year.
